summary: For the last several years this neighbourhood's record has been the city taking over its hotels. It leased the Adante on Geary Street and the Monarch further up the same street as temporary shelter, extended its lease on the Pacific Bay Inn on Jones, and kept 459 rooms at 1231 Market. In 2019 it let 101 Hyde Street, a building it owns, to La Cocina for $12,000 a year, with a million-dollar gift from the San Francisco Foundation behind it. Liquor licences move from address to address here more than anywhere else in the city.
